Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL1075097. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and activities to molecule_dictionary then compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
